near_miss = something that almost went wrong, but didn't
  e.g. caught a hardcoded credential before it merged
  e.g. flagged a suspicious email before clicking it

# high near-miss reporting rate -> people trust the system
# low near-miss reporting rate  -> people have learned to stay quiet
caption: A near-miss shows a control working at the exact moment of human judgment, for free.
